notes: Pick your weather location: search for your city under Settings > Weather location, or re-detect automatically - fixes wrong-city weather, sunrise times, and ISS passes. Fill mode fills again: portrait photos crop to full screen when fill is selected, on landscape and portrait-mounted Portals alike. Large shared albums (100+ photos) now load reliably - Apple's servers just needed more patience than we gave them. The Android Recents button only appears with the system bar now and gained an off switch. Home Assistant: microphone mute stays in sync, and the inaudible volume controls are hidden on Portal TV.
